card.name: Linking words before dyes, sutures, anesthetics
card.fires_on: Small linking words or number parts (of, using, use, a comma, a decimal 0) just before a named material in procedural text. The material is a dye, suture or local anesthetic.

modes.label: Of or using before a material
modes.description: The word of, use or using comes right before a dye, suture or anesthetic name.
modes.example: Close the conjunctiva and Tenon’s capsule<< using>> 6-0 plain gut or chrom

modes.label: Amount or concentration step
modes.description: A number part or space inside a dose or concentration just before the agent or material.
modes.example: Inject TissueBlue 0.<<0>>25% directly in a Balanced Salt

modes.label: List of dyes
modes.description: A comma inside a list of staining dyes.
modes.example: organic staining dyes such as methylene blue, toluidine blue, rose bengal<<,>> and methyl orange.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward names of materials and away from company-style endings like Inc.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before a dye, suture or numbing drug is named in procedure steps.
